title: ビジネスデータサイエンス(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: Data Science for Business
courseType:
(Provided by all courses)
Liberal Arts Courses

educationalGoal: Students will learn fundamentals and basic methods of data analysis, and then they will practice practical exercises such as collecting, summarizing, and analyzing of data. This course will help students to understand how data analysis works in businesses. And this course also will help them to understand advanced data science topics such as Artificial Intelligence.
advice: In this course, students will learn data analysis as a method for utilizing data through lectures and exercises. The course contents includes fundamentals of descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing in inferential statistics, regression analysis, cluster analysis, decision tree analysis, artificial neural network and textmining. Each class contains both classroom lecture and hands-on analysis exercises. We will use "Microsoft Excel", "KNIME", and "KHCoder". KNIME is a freeware statistical software, and KHCoder is a text mining tool.
requiredKnowledge: This lecture needs three softwares: 1) Microsoft Excel, 2) statistical software KNIME (https://www.knime.com/), and 3) text mining tool KHCoder (https://www.knime.com/). Students should install them on each own PC before taking this course.

activityGoals.body: Able to test for statistically significant differences in representative values such as means
Able to use appropriate multiple regression analysis for given data
Able to explain some statistical methods and data mining methods in data science
Able to conduct prediction, classification, and knowledge discovery using data science methods
Able to recognize the significance data science methods and their limitations
